About us

Gugu Basel brings together weekend activities in and around Basel, practical family guides, and family-friendly deals across Switzerland — all independently curated to make family planning easier.

Created and independently managed by a mom, Kübra Bulut Sengupta, based in Basel, Switzerland.

Terms

Information is provided for general guidance. Event details, prices, discounts, stock and booking conditions can change. Please confirm current information directly with organisers or retailers before visiting, booking or buying; featured deals are not guaranteed to be the lowest price.

Gugu Basel curates information but does not organise events, sell tickets or retail products. Third-party websites, services and transactions are subject to their own terms and remain outside our control.

Any sponsored content, paid partnerships or affiliate links will be clearly labelled. Editorial inclusion is not a guarantee or endorsement.

Original Gugu Basel content and branding are protected where applicable. Third-party materials and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Privacy

Gugu Basel is designed to collect as little visitor data as reasonably possible. The website does not use a contact form and does not ask visitors to create an account.

Website Analytics

We use Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors interact with Gugu Basel and improve the website, including which pages and links are used. Clarity is configured with advertising and analytics cookie storage denied by default.

For more information about how Microsoft handles data, please see Microsoft’s Privacy Statement.

Technical data may still be processed by website hosting, DNS and infrastructure providers as necessary to deliver, operate and secure the website. Their processing is governed by their own terms and privacy practices.

Gugu Basel currently provides contact through Instagram DM rather than a website contact form. Information you choose to send through Instagram is processed under Instagram's own terms and privacy practices.

The website contains external links to Instagram, event organisers, venues, retailers and other third-party websites. When you open an external link, the destination service's own privacy policy and data-processing practices apply.

Gugu Basel does not sell personal data to advertisers or other third parties.
